source_claims.claim: The monkey types iid letters from the three-key alphabet {a,b,c}, and the two target patterns are abab and aabb.
A one-letter bet with stake m is fair because the correct key has probability 1/3 and pays 3m gross.
At the first abab stopping time, two gamblers remain, giving terminal team gain (T-2)(-1)+(81-1)+(9-1)=90-T.
At the first aabb stopping time, one gambler remains, giving terminal team gain (T-1)(-1)+(81-1)=81-T.
The stopped gambling team is a martingale satisfying the bounded-increment optional-stopping condition of Theorem 13.18, so expected terminal gain is zero.
The expected waiting times are E[T_abab]=90 and E[T_aabb]=81, so aabb has the smaller expected waiting time.
The displayed sample averages 89.1899 and 81.2196 are empirical checks consistent with the theoretical values.
